design_rule: every Stage 1 artefact is a NEW file; no edit to runner.py, signal_layer.py, replay_checkpoint.py, run_live_day.py or run_scheduler.py

1A_schema_v2_module.reuse: import fingerprint() from replay_checkpoint verbatim; do not copy it
tests: pos round-trip keeps entry_day/entry_time as pd.Timestamp
1A_schema_v2_module.rollback: delete the file; nothing imports it
1A_schema_v2_module.gate: v1 file refused by v2 loader AND v2 file refused by replay_checkpoint.load()

1B_params_hash.isolation: pure function config -> (readable string, hash); no I/O, no engine import
tests: one mutation test per field in params_hash
same config -> same hash across processes
1B_params_hash.gate: every params_hash field has a test that goes red when the field is removed from the hash input
1B_params_hash.why_highest_value: the params-mismatch refusal branch has never fired in production

1C_route_path_and_keyspace.note: run_live_day already has --checkpoint-path (:179); Stage 1 uses it only from tests
tests: writing route A leaves route B byte-identical
two sleeves on one instrument coexist
1C_route_path_and_keyspace.gate: the does-not-clobber test fails when the per-key merge is removed

1D_window_ledger.isolation: append-only JSONL, off unless an env var names a directory, never raises, never decides
1D_window_ledger.gate: simulated suspend yields window_unobserved AND a quiet window yields no_signal, distinguishable without reading any other file

1E_equivalence_harness.isolation: offline, parquet only; no IBKR, no live bars, no runner
1E_equivalence_harness.anchor: must reproduce the existing shadow record (91 matched / 0 diverged, 2026-08-10..2026-08-21) before judging anything new
1E_equivalence_harness.gate: anchor reproduced, then a deliberately corrupted resume state is detected

1F_telemetry_phases.note: phase names declared here, implemented in Stage 2 alongside the route code
1F_telemetry_phases.key_rule: oracle_replay timed separately and EXCLUDED from the route p95
1F_telemetry_phases.gate: deferred to Stage 2 (R7: p95 < 300s hard, < 240s target)

1G_scheduler_review.finding: _catch_up_maxhold (run_scheduler.py:1132) is startup-only, called at :1243; a running scheduler that sleeps through 09:31 and is not restarted gets neither the cron run nor the catch-up
1G_scheduler_review.stage2_shape: evaluate the same predicate on the heartbeat as well as at startup: no new job, no new trigger, no argv change
1G_scheduler_review.blocker: _maxhold_done and _preflight_ok are date-keyed and persisted; they need a route dimension before a second route runs in the same scheduler process
1G_scheduler_review.gate: Stage 2 may not add a Track 1 window until this is fixed or accepted in writing with the residual named

schema_v2.empty_sleeve_rationale: same-session sleeves need no historical checkpoint; present-but-empty says accounted for, absent would say nobody thought about it
schema_v2.rowcount_vs_content_split_rationale: 48 of the 64 historical skips were rowcount, 4 were content; different causes, and this session had to reconstruct the split by string-diffing hashes out of log lines
lost_update_fix: keep atomic whole-file write (.tmp then replace)
per-key merge: a writer may only replace keys under its own route
write-scope assertion: every key outside the writer's route byte-identical to what was loaded
schema_v2.cheaper_alternative: one file per route removes the merge problem entirely; take it at Stage 2 if the lock adds latency inside the runtime gate

filters: r4_range_p90 threshold AND its derivation window
data: fill law in force (all-bars-gappable vs >15min rule)
rules: hashlib.sha256 over a canonical sorted rendering; never Python hash() (salted per process)
floats at fixed precision so 2.5 and 2.50 cannot disagree
a field that cannot be tested is not added
thresholds derived from a window carry the window, not just the value

window_ledger.rationale: a checkpoint answers what state the last observation left; the ledger answers whether an observation happened at all

outcomes.unobserved: no window_closed record exists at all - the fail-closed signal

window_ledger.fail_closed_property: absence of window_closed is itself the signal; a suspended host writes nothing, and nothing must read as failure
cross_checks: scheduler HEARTBEAT STALLED, measured to match a real OS suspend 28 of 28
Windows Power-Troubleshooter log, which caught 39 suspends against the scheduler's 28

equivalence.tolerance: exact to stored rounding, no epsilon
equivalence.skipped_comparison: counts as a FAILED day, not neutral
equivalence.divergence: one divergence resets the promotion counter to zero
equivalence.post_promotion: oracle keeps running (R8); a divergence then is a rollback trigger

offline_tests.note: branch that has never fired in production

offline_tests.what: sleeve mismatch refuses as no_entry, never a silent hit
missing checkpoint fails closed, no entries, not a silent full replay
stale checkpoint fails closed even when the fingerprint matches

test_discipline: each test mutation-checked: break the guard, confirm the right test goes red, restore
stage1_exit_criteria: all offline tests pass and each shown to go red on its own mutation
equivalence harness reproduces the existing shadow record before judging anything new
params_hash covers every listed field, each with its own mutation test
ledger distinguishes unobserved from no_signal without consulting another file
legacy byte-identical: no edit to the five files, artifact sha256 matches, empty job/argv diff, 44 baseline tests still pass
Stage 1G scheduler review written down with the residual either scheduled or accepted
not_in_stage1: any edit to the five legacy files
unsettled: R0 host availability unchanged: 8 of the 9 most recent trading days had an S3 suspend; idle timer already off so STANDBYIDLE 0 is not the remedy for this host
the run_day cost of Track 1's two same-session sleeves is unmeasured; Stage 1 is offline and produces no p95; the margin at stake is 84s
_maxhold_done and _preflight_ok are date-keyed and persisted and need a route dimension before a second route shares the scheduler process
